card.name: Leading digits of numbers and list items
card.fires_on: A single digit that starts a number in web text, such as the first digit of a day, a year, a street number, a section number or a numbered list item. It often follows a space, a sentence end or a partial number like 1.

modes.label: Dates and years
modes.description: A digit inside a day or year, often 8 or 9 in a date.
